failure_modes.cause: BPR set below required 1.58 bar, leading to potential vaporization of solvent
failure_modes.mitigation: Adjust BPR to at least 1.58 bar to prevent solvent vaporization

failure_modes.cause: Suboptimal photon penetration due to incorrect reactor geometry or fouling
failure_modes.mitigation: Ensure reactor geometry supports optimal photon delivery and regularly clean reactor to prevent fouling

failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 30°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.29766 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR adjustment to 1.58 bar and monitor system stability over 2 hours
Conduct photon penetration efficiency test using a light-sensitive dye to ensure uniform illumination
